title: Doctrine: a contract test may pin only surfaces its own capability owns (another rung's absence is never a floor)
objective: Close GOV-0117 (#268). Three rung-floor assertions in one session pinned the ABSENCE of something, read as contracts and behaved as freezes; the third pinned two evidence types badf-production-readiness does not own and deadlocked a badf-uat rung. The class is recorded at both instance sites -- a docstring in test_badf_uat_contract.py, an in-line comment in test_badf_production_readiness_contract.py -- but a reader writing a NEW contract test opens neither.
business_value: A freeze wearing a contract's clothes fails correctly, which is what makes it expensive: the test is right about the snapshot and wrong about the world, and none of the three is caught by a mutation battery because neutering the assertion turns the suite green. Doctrine in the ledger a reader consults is the only place this reaches the next author.
in_scope: docs/governance/GITHUB_CONTROL_PLANE.md: one appended section stating the rule, the INVARIANT-vs-SNAPSHOT distinction, the three instances, why it is doctrine rather than a guard, and how it differs from #250 and #234
carry the WP-2026-0134 reconcile (byte-identical to the copies in #316/#321/#326/#327; NOT #314's, which asserts a different tree)
out_of_scope: a mechanical guard: assertNotIn(own_type, ...) and assertNotIn(other_type, ...) are structurally identical and only one is wrong, so a detector needs intent rather than structure -- stated in the section rather than deferred silently
editing the two instance sites: both already carry the lesson and both are correct
the G07 self-dossier: BADF-DEM-0131 is kind=discovery / status=OPEN, so self_dossier (:4007) refuses it until a human authorizes. Declared, not worked around.
acceptance_criteria: the rule appears as the section's first line in the compressed form 'another rung's absence is never a floor', so a skimming reader gets the rule before the argument
the section states WHY it is doctrine and not a guard, naming the structural-identity problem that defeats a detector
it distinguishes the class from #250 (a correct guard nothing watches) and #234 (a guard vacuous over an empty set) as correct, watched, non-vacuous, and asserting the wrong thing

it names where each instance-site record lives PRECISELY -- a docstring in one file, an in-line comment in the other -- because a doctrine line that mis-describes where its own evidence lives sends the next reader to the wrong place

ADVERSARIAL (#270): the proposition is 'a reader takes this section as licence to delete an absence-assertion'. Enumerate the absence-assertions the rule does NOT condemn -- a capability pinning its OWN type's absence before its own B rung is correct and must stay -- and confirm the section cannot be read as forbidding them.
evidence: the 3 tests referencing this file green

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: Docs-only (C1): no enforcement control is introduced or strengthened -- and the section says why one cannot be, which is the finding. Authority chain openly incomplete: demand is kind=discovery with no authorized_by, legible as such in the record.
